blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.
blocks.zh: 互动的世界模式必须不断生成视频,同时迅速回应用户的行动。 仅实时吞吐量就留下了输入延迟未解决的问题:粗体生成块会延迟动作更新,输入后生成会给响应路径添加工作. 我们引入了ShowNow(ShowNow),一个精细的投机流线框架,它使用在回放时可用的计算,在输入到来之前准备有行动条件的未来. 单方承诺可以经常作出决定,而可描述的准备涵盖一至八项行动。 我们构建一个匹配的多未来数据集,从一个共同状态来训练替代的续作;共享历史树的被执行和被融合的承诺使得其编写效率高. 在单一的H100上,我们的5B模型维持了480p的生成量为16fps,并有8个备好的未来. 在"ViZDoom"中,ShowNow的完整部署相对于本土块"SolarWM-FT"的部署,将中位输入-播放后置从620米降低到208米. 相匹配的政策实验将重启的空勾从1.56%减少到0.09%(94%)并改进对动作变化的实时响应. 这些成果为精细承诺和预先准备确立了互补作用,在视觉忠诚和长期一致性方面进行了权衡取舍。 ShowNow将回放时的计算转换为响应视觉交互. 项目:https://github.com/showlab/SshowNow。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive world models must sustain visual generation and respond promptly to user actions. A stream can reach its target frame rate while still displaying the consequences of an earlier command, weakening interactive control [ 23 ] . Occasional long delays can disrupt turns or evasive actions; in embodied and teleoperated systems, stale visual feedback can reduce the margin for correction. Responsive generation therefore requires frequent action decisions and low input-to-display latency, including its tail.
blocks.zh: 互动的世界模式必须维持视觉生成,并对用户的行动迅速作出反应。 一个流可以达到目标帧速率,同时仍然显示一个早期指令的后果,削弱交互控制[23]. 偶尔长时间的拖延会干扰转弯或逃避动作;在体现的和远程操作的系统中,呆滞的视觉反馈会减少修正的空间. 因此,应变生成需要频繁的行动决定和低投入-散射延迟,包括其尾部.

blocks.en: Recent models produce increasingly convincing, controllable, and streamable worlds [ 27 , 11 , 26 , 13 ] . Acceleration through fewer sampling steps and faster execution makes real-time throughput possible. Playback-paced interaction introduces another opportunity: compute can be scheduled while previously committed frames are playing. Our matched measurements reveal substantial compute slack in reactive streaming. This motivates a complementary design axis: prepare possible continuations before input arrives, then select using the latest action . Its value depends on preparing useful candidates within the playback budget and providing frequent commitment opportunities.
blocks.zh: 最近的模型产生越来越有说服力、可控和可流转的世界[27、11、26、13]。 通过较少的采样步骤加快速度和更快的执行使得实时吞吐成为可能. 回放节奏互动引入了另一个机会:计算可以在之前承诺的帧播放时被安排. 相匹配的测量结果显示 反应性流变中存在很大的误差 这激励了一个互补的设计轴:在输入到达前准备可能的续作,然后使用最新的动作选择. 其价值取决于在回放预算中为有用的候选人做好准备,并提供频繁的承诺机会。

blocks.en: ShowNow develops this idea into fine-grained speculative streaming (Fig. 1 ). Single-latent updates shorten the commitment horizon, while configurable preparation covers one to eight possible actions. One-future preparation exploits action persistence and regenerates when the command changes [ 43 , 36 ] . Broader coverage prepares alternatives from the same committed state, allowing a changed action to select a ready continuation. The selected timeline becomes the common history for the next round. This couples temporal granularity, action coverage and repeated commitment in one streaming interface. Our supported actions include movement, turning, firing, and jumping.
blocks.zh: 现在显示这个想法发展成精细的投机流(图1). 一次性更新缩短了承诺范围,而可配置的准备涵盖1至8项可能的行动。 当命令改变时, " 一日准备 " 利用动作持久性和再生性[43、36]。 扩大覆盖面,从同一承诺状态准备替代方案,以便改变行动,选择现成的延续。 选定的时间段成为下一轮的共同历史. 这对夫妇的时间颗粒性,动作覆盖度和在一个流线界面的重复承诺. 我们支持的行动包括行动、转弯、射击和跳跃。

blocks.en: Making this cycle practical raises two connected challenges. The model must produce distinct, action-consistent futures from a shared state, and the runtime must prepare them before their common playback deadline. We construct matched multi-future trajectories by restoring identical simulator states, supplying aligned supervision for alternative action consequences. Building on SolarWM’s Wan2.2 5B backbone [ 13 ] , teacher adaptation, AnyFlow distillation and Self-Forcing refinement yield a three-step causal generator [ 7 , 12 ] . Branch-tree attention then keeps future branches isolated while reusing their historical context. Shared-prefix methods such as Hydragen [ 47 ] , FlashInfer [ 48 ] and SGLang [ 49 ] accelerate language-model inference; we adapt this execution principle to action-conditioned multi-future video, where the user’s selection determines the history carried into the next cycle. Fused commitment further moves the selected history update into generation, shortening the work remaining after a decision.
blocks.zh: 使这一周期切实可行,提出了两个相互关联的挑战。 该模式必须产生与共享状态不同的、与行动一致的未来,运行时间必须在他们共同的回放最后期限之前做好准备。 我们通过恢复相同的模拟状态来构建匹配的多未来轨迹,为替代行动后果提供一致的监督。 利用SolarWM的Wan2.2 5B主干线[13],师资改造,AnyFlow蒸馏和自强制精炼产生三步因子生成器[7,12]. 然后,树枝的注意力使未来的树枝被隔离,同时重新利用它们的历史背景。 Hydragen [47], FlashInfer [48] 和 SGLang [49] 等共享前缀方法加速语言模型推论;我们把这一执行原则适应动作条件的多未来视频,其中用户的选择决定了传入下一个周期的历史. 知情承诺进一步将选定的历史更新推向生成过程,缩短了在作出决定后余下的工作。

blocks.en: The resulting system sustains eight-future streaming at 16 fps on one H100. A matched compute benchmark shows that shared-history execution reduces generation time by 10% and peak memory by 48% relative to batching eight independent sequences (Fig. 3 (c)). These savings make broader action coverage affordable, while the response-window analysis identifies when that coverage matters: a prepared alternative can meet a display deadline after the opportunity to regenerate has passed. This analysis links candidate readiness to interaction outcomes and motivates continuous-stream and controlled-switch evaluation.
blocks.zh: 由此形成的系统在1架H100上维持了16英尺的八未来流. 一个匹配的计算基准显示,与分批8个独立序列相比,共享历史执行将生成时间减少10%,峰值内存减少48%(图3(c))。 这些节省使更广泛的行动覆盖面能够负担得起,而反应窗口分析则指出,这种覆盖面何时重要:在再生机会过去之后,一个已准备好的替代办法可以达到展示期限。 这一分析将候选人的准备状态与互动结果联系起来,并激励进行连续的、有控制的切换评价。

blocks.en: Our experiments show how fine-grained commitment, efficient execution and advance preparation contribute to responsive streaming. Under matched runtime and read-ahead, separately trained single- and three-latent deployments demonstrate the response benefit associated with finer commitment (Table 1 ). Runtime optimization lowers commit-side work and frees preparation capacity. Within the optimized student, eight-future preparation reduces restart empty ticks by 94% while preserving comparable presentation quantiles (Table 3 ). Uniform-phase switches show a 13-percentage-point gain in scheduled-target attainment over One Future (Fig. 3 ). With four actions and six sampling steps at native 16 fps, both One Future and Four Futures reduce presentation P99 relative to Reactive (Sec. 4.3 ). The 32 fps study evaluates 2 × 2\times playback of content trained at 16 fps and shows near-target playback with prepared futures and a shallow queue (Fig. 4 ). These results link commitment granularity to response time and preparation to continuity and deadline readiness.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,精细的承诺、高效的执行和预先准备如何有助于反应迅速的流畅。 在相应的运行时间和读取前,经过单独培训的单级和三级部署显示与更精细承诺相关的反应效益(表1)。 运行时间优化降低承诺侧工作,释放准备能力. 在最优化的学生中,八未来的准备将重新开始的空勾减少94%,同时保留可比的演示文稿四分位数(表3 )。 统一阶段开关显示,在一个未来实现预定目标方面将增加13个百分点(图3)。 通过在原生的16 fps的4个动作和6个采样步骤,"一个未来"和"四个未来"都相对反应减少P99的演示(第4.3节). 32 fps研究评价2×2\times回放在16 fps训练中的内容,并显示近目标回放的准备期货和浅排队(图4). 这些成果将承诺的颗粒性与反应时间和准备工作与连续性和最后期限准备挂钩。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A framework for generation ahead of input. We introduce ShowNow, which turns playback-time computation into timely action responses through fine-grained prepare–select–commit decisions. The framework unifies single- and multi-future preparation, providing a configurable compute–response trade-off for world models. • A dataset and training pipeline for multiple futures. We construct and release a matched multi-future dataset with eight action-conditioned continuations from common world states, covering held actions and action switches. Multi-future training and causal distillation equip the model to prepare alternative continuations from shared history, supporting multi-future interaction. • Single-GPU real-time multi-future generation. Shared-history tree execution and fused commitment enable a 5B model to sustain 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures on one H100. System evaluations demonstrate substantially lower input-to-display latency for the complete deployment, while matched-policy studies establish further gains in playback continuity and on-time response through advance preparation.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:在投入之前先建立一代人的框架。 我们引入了ShowNow(ShowNow),它通过精细的准备-选择-承诺决定将回放时间计算转化为及时的动作响应. 该框架统一了单一和多未来的准备,为世界模型提供了可配置的计算-反应权衡。 • 支助 多期货的数据集和培训管道. 我们构建并发布了一个匹配的多未来数据集,其中包含来自共同世界国家的8个有行动条件的续作,涵盖已有的行动和行动开关. 多未来培训和因果衍射使模型能够从共享历史中准备替代续作,支持多未来互动. • 单一GPU实时多未来生成。 共享历史树执行和融合承诺使得5B模型能够在16 fps维持480p的生成,在1 H100上的8个准备期货. 系统评价表明,投入与披露的延迟性大大降低,而对应的政策研究则通过预先准备,进一步增加了回放的连续性和及时反应。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Interactive World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 互动世界模式

blocks.en: GameGAN, Genie, DIAMOND, and GameNGen establish interactive visual dynamics [ 15 , 2 , 1 , 27 ] . MineWorld, Matrix-Game, GameCraft, Yume, Matrix-Game 2.0, and WorldPlay extend action-conditioned streaming generation [ 8 , 34 , 17 , 21 , 11 , 26 ] ; WorldMem, VMem, and Matrix-Game 3.5 address persistence [ 29 , 19 , 22 ] . Sekai and SolarWM provide data and training foundations [ 18 , 13 ] . OpenWorldLib [ 59 ] organizes perception, interaction and memory within a unified world-model framework. WorldWander [ 55 ] studies synchronized egocentric and exocentric video generation, broadening the viewpoints available for visual interaction. Speculative rendering in Outatime [ 43 ] anticipates game-engine outcomes; ShowNow instead prepares learned generative futures from a committed visual history. Next-frame speculation [ 36 ] motivates lightweight preparation, while ActionSplice [ 38 ] edits actions during in-flight generation. ShowNow develops configurable action coverage with matched multi-future training and shared-history execution: input selects a prepared continuation, which becomes the common history for the next round. Single-latent decisions and branch-tree execution fit this repeated prepare–select–commit cycle within a single-GPU budget.

blocks.en: 2.2 Controllable Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 可控视频生成

blocks.en: Camera and motion controls condition video generation on geometry, trajectories and local edits [ 9 , 10 , 28 , 33 ] . Follow Your Pose [ 60 ] learns pose-guided video synthesis, Follow-Your-Click [ 61 ] animates selected regions with motion prompts, and MagicStick [ 62 ] edits video properties through transformed control handles. Follow-Your-Creation [ 63 ] uses video inpainting to support camera changes and edits in 4D creation. These controls provide complementary ways to specify visual dynamics.
blocks.zh: 相机和运动控制条件 几何,轨迹和当地编辑的视频生成 [9,10,28,33]. 跟着你的Pose [60] 学习姿势引导的视频合成,跟随你的Click [61] 动画部分区域有运动提示,而MagicStick [62]通过变形控制柄编辑视频属性. Follow-Your-Creation [63] 在4D创建中使用视频插图支持相机修改和编辑. 这些控制提供了补充方式来指定视觉动态.

blocks.en: Conditional video editing also develops data and architectures for preserving structure while changing appearance. VISTA [ 53 ] learns video stylization from aligned triplets, IC-Effect [ 58 ] uses contextual video conditions for effect editing, and PAI-Studio [ 57 ] synthesizes motion-consistent backgrounds. PAI-Actor [ 56 ] extends character replacement to multiple subjects and distills a bidirectional model into an autoregressive generator. MakeAnything [ 50 ] studies coherent procedural sequences, while Mitty [ 54 ] and OmniHumanoid [ 51 ] transfer motion across human and robot embodiments. These studies demonstrate the value of aligned supervision and task-specific conditioning for controllable visual sequences. Matched action rollouts support studying divergent futures [ 37 ] ; ShowNow constructs such futures from identical ViZDoom states [ 14 ] and prepares them for repeated input-driven selection during continuous interaction.
blocks.zh: 有条件的视频编辑也在改变外观的同时开发了保存结构的数据和架构. VISTA [53] 从对齐的三重奏中学习视频结构化,IC-Effect [58] 使用上下文视频条件进行效果编辑,PAI-Studio [57] 合成运动-一致的背景. PAI-Actor [56] 将字符替换扩展到多个主体,并将双向模型提炼成自动递归生成器. Make anything [50] 研究连贯的程序序列,而Mitty [54]和Omni Humanoid [51] 跨越人和机器人的浮雕的转移运动. 这些研究表明,对可控视觉序列进行对齐的监管和任务特定条件的价值。 匹配的动作展开支持研究不同的期货 [37]; ShowNow从相同的ViZDoom状态构建这样的期货 [14],并准备在持续互动中重复输入驱动的选择.

blocks.en: 2.3 Efficient and Speculative Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 高效和分散的生成

blocks.en: Diffusion Forcing, CausVid, Self Forcing, Self Gradient Forcing, LongLive, and Causal Forcing++ develop causal rollouts, fine-grained generation, and distillation [ 4 , 31 , 12 , 35 , 42 , 41 ] . Progressive, consistency, distribution-matching, and AnyFlow methods reduce sampling steps [ 24 , 25 , 20 , 30 , 32 , 7 ] ; StreamDiffusionV2 addresses streaming schedules and rolling caches [ 40 ] . StreamingEffect [ 52 ] applies causal distillation and online keyframe control to real-time video editing. These streaming designs motivate coordinating generation with incoming controls; ShowNow additionally prepares action alternatives before their selection deadline. SDVG accepts drafted video blocks through quality routing [ 39 ] , whereas ShowNow selects futures by user action. Language-model speculative decoding accelerates generation through draft verification [ 16 , 3 ] ; SpecInfer [ 44 ] , Medusa [ 45 ] and EAGLE [ 46 ] develop tree-structured proposals. ShowNow applies shared-history execution to action-conditioned video futures: user input selects a branch at a playback deadline, and fused commitment installs its clean history for subsequent generation. Partitioned attention uses the standard log-sum-exp merge. FlashAttention improves the underlying attention efficiency [ 5 , 6 ] .

blocks.en: 4.1 Settings and Measurement
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置和计量

blocks.en: SolarWM-FT retains the native three-latent block after fine-tuning on the same data with the same teacher and post-training stages. Timing and quality evaluation use the same trained SolarWM-FT model, with FastTree execution and automatic four-frame lead. The ShowNow student uses three sampling steps, one latent per update, 15 history latents, and optimized BF16/FA3 execution with fused commitment. Within ShowNow, Reactive generates after input, One Future prepares the held action and regenerates on a change, and multi-future configurations cover supported actions. Matched comparisons share checkpoint, runtime, traces and TAEHV. A queue threshold of one or zero remaining frames triggers selection; each update appends four frames without flushing.
blocks.zh: SolarWM-FT在对同一数据进行微调后保留了原生的三纬区块,该区块的教师和培训后阶段相同。 时间和质量评价使用相同的训练有素的SolarWM-FT模型,有FastTree执行和自动四帧领先. ShowNow学生采用三个抽样步骤,每个更新一个潜在步骤,15个历史潜伏步骤,并优化了BF16/FA3执行,并做出了保险承诺。 在ShowNow内部,反应在输入后生成,One Future在变化中准备持有的动作和再生,多未来配置覆盖支持的动作. 匹配的比较共享检查点,运行时间,跟踪和TAEHV. 队列阈值为1或0余帧触发选择;每个更新附加4帧而不冲刷.

blocks.en: 4.2 Response and Preparation Cost
blocks.zh: 4.2 反应和准备费用

blocks.en: SolarWM-FT records 620/983/1385 ms presentation P50/P90/P99 with automatic lead. Matching one-frame lead and FastTree execution across the trained B3 and B1 deployments gives medians of 536 and 210 ms, respectively (Table 1 ). B3’s shorter lead trades response against playback continuity, while optimized B1 execution frees compute for preparation. The eight-future deployment achieves 208/345/374 ms at 15.99 fps. At zero-frame threshold, matched Reactive/One/Eight presentation triples are 152/279/392, 148/279/312 and 144/277/312 ms (Table 3 ).

blocks.en: In matched six-seed 16 fps runs, Reactive/One Future use 19%/25% GPU busy time. Eight futures use 80%, sustain 15.99 fps and reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09%, with comparable presentation quantiles (208/345/374 versus 211/344/373 ms; Table 3 ). GPU busy fraction measures generation, commitment and decoding GPU time divided by wall time. This operating point converts playback-time compute capacity into broader action coverage while preserving real-time playback.

Lead specifies the pending-frame threshold for selection. The 32 FPS setting evaluates 2 × 2\times playback of content trained at 16 fps; FPS reports achieved playback throughput.

blocks.en: Preparation reduces median input-to-commit from 136 ms for Reactive to 86/88 ms for one/eight futures. Queueing can align prepared and regenerated responses to the same display slot. Preparation becomes valuable near deadlines or with shallow queues, where regeneration can delay display. All three policies have no observed ongoing empty ticks at the one-frame threshold (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 制备量将中位输入至承诺量从反射136ms降低至1/8期货86/88ms. 排队可以将已准备和再生成的响应对齐到同一个显示槽. 准备在期限附近或排浅队时变得有价值,在那里再生可以延迟显示. 所有这三项政策均没有观察到在一框架阈值上正在发生的空勾(表3)。

blocks.en: Figure 3 (a,b) shows how preparation covers action changes close to a presentation deadline. At tested leads from 6 to 40 ms, eight prepared alternatives meet the shared target in every measured trial, whereas one-future preparation requires regeneration and waits approximately one additional frame. Across all 500 uniform-phase pairs, coverage increases target attainment by 13.0 percentage points, from 83.8% to 96.8%, with a mean presentation gain of 9.2 ms (paired 95% CI [7.0,12.0]). This identifies the mechanism’s practical benefit: keeping the next display deadline reachable when input changes late.
blocks.zh: 图3(a,b)显示准备如何涵盖接近提交期限的行动变化。 在经过测试的6至40毫秒的线索中,有8种已准备好的替代品在每次测量试验中都达到了共同目标,而一未来的准备则需要再生,并等待大约一个额外的框架。 在所有500对单相配对中,覆盖率提高了13.0%的目标实现率,从83.8%提高到96.8%,平均显示增益为9.2 ms(交付95%CI[7.0,12.0])。 这明确了机制的实际好处:在输入变化较晚时保持下一个显示截止时间。

blocks.en: In a 32 fps accelerated-playback stress test ( 2 × 2\times playback of 16 fps-trained content), preparation allows a shallow queue while sustaining near-target throughput (Fig. 4 ). At zero-frame threshold, Reactive reaches 25.26 fps with 15.88% ongoing empty ticks; One Future reaches 31.34 fps, and Four Futures reaches 31.96 fps with no observed ongoing empty ticks. The optimized Reactive path starts when no undisplayed frame remains, exposing about 50.1 ms of generation with fused commitment plus 3.5 ms decoding. A display tick is 31.25 ms; prepared candidates remove generation from this empty-queue response path. Tick losses depend on scheduling phase as well as mean update cost.
blocks.zh: 在32fps加速回放应力测试(2×2\times回放16fps训练内容)中,准备允许浅排队,同时维持近目标吞吐量(图4). 在零帧阈值下,反应达到25.26英尺,有15.88%的空勾; "一个未来"达到31.34英尺,"四个未来"达到31.96英尺,没有观测到正在进行中的空勾. 优化的反射路径在没有未显示的帧残留时开始,暴露出约50.1毫秒的生成,并带有引信承诺加上3.5毫秒的解码. 显示勾选为31.25毫秒;准备中的候选人从这个空序响应路径中移除生成. 罚单损失取决于时间安排阶段以及平均更新费用。

blocks.en: Raising Reactive’s threshold to one frame restores 31.38 fps and reduces ongoing empty ticks to 0.008%, with presentation P50/P90/P99 of 106/169/184 ms. Four Futures at threshold zero gives 73/137/153 ms, illustrating the measured buffering–latency trade-off. Table 3 reports the full policy–threshold comparison on shared input traces. Quality in Table 2 is evaluated at the 16 fps training rate. At threshold zero, Four versus One Future further reduces P50/P90/P99 by 5/4/2 ms; the P90/P99 confidence intervals exclude zero. Thus preparation and buffering jointly set the response budget, with extra coverage improving readiness and continuity.
blocks.zh: 将反应的阈值提升到一个帧可以恢复31.38英尺,并将进行中的空勾降低到0.008%,演示文稿P50/P90/P99为106/169/184毫秒. 四期货在零阈值下给出73/137/153 ms,说明了所测量的缓冲 - 纬度权衡. 表3报告共享输入痕迹的全面政策门槛比较。 表2中的质量按16 fps培训率评价. 在阈值0,四对一未来进一步将P50/P90/P99减少5/4/2 ms;P90/P99置信间隔排除0. 因此,编制和缓冲共同确定了应急预算,额外涵盖范围则提高了准备程度和连续性。

blocks.en: Shared-history execution reduces eight-candidate generation from 301.8 to 271.6 ms against batch-eight independent sequences in a matched FA2 benchmark, with peak allocated memory falling from 32.8 to 17.1 GiB. Serial independent generation takes 478.8 ms. In a separate matched FA3 benchmark, the tree fits the 250 ms GPU update budget with all deployment optimizations disabled (235.1 ms) and enabled (229.9 ms), including commitment and decoding. Fused commitment shortens the post-decision path from approximately 17.5 to 3.5 ms. Figure 3 (c) separates the shared-history and runtime comparisons.
blocks.zh: 共享历史执行将8个指定数的生成从301.8米减少到271.6米,与匹配的FA2基准中的8批独立序列相对应,峰值分配内存从32.8降至17.1 GiB. 序列独立生成需要478.8米. 在单独匹配的FA3基准中,树符合250ms GPU更新预算,所有部署优化被禁用(235.1ms)并启用(229.9ms),包括承诺和解码. 知情承诺将决策后路径从17.5毫秒缩短到3.5毫秒。 图3(c)将共享历史和运行时间的比较分开。

blocks.en: 4.3 Control, Quality and Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.3 控制、质量和缺陷

blocks.en: Single-latent commitment performs 240 autoregressive updates per minute, compared with 80 for B3, enabling more frequent action decisions. In the first 0.5 s after a switch, accuracy is 0.813 versus 0.591 for SolarWM-FT; settled accuracy is 0.901 versus 0.969 (Table 2 ). Overall accuracy is 0.860, while validation LPIPS is 0.437 versus normal inference’s 0.416. On 500 isolated switches, IDM-detected action-effect median/P90 latency falls from SolarWM-FT’s 603/987 ms to ShowNow’s 297/815 ms. Figure 5 (a) shows generated ViZDoom clips under changing actions.
blocks.zh: 单向承诺每分钟进行240次自动更新,而B3为80次,从而能够更频繁地作出行动决定。 在开关后的首个0.5s中,SolarWM-FT的精度为0.813对0.591;确定精度为0.901对0.969(表2)。 总精度为0.860,而验证LPIPS为0.437,而正常推论为0.416. 在500个孤立开关上,IDM探测到的动作效果中位数/P90 耐用度从SolarWM-FT的603/987 ms下降到ShowNow的297/815 ms. 图5(a)显示在变化中的行动中生成的ViZDoom剪辑。

blocks.en: Across nine paired noise seeds on 20 held-out one-minute scenes, the deployed path has mean FD 11.4 and key accuracy .772; disabling deployment fusions gives 8.3 and .785. The FD difference is sensitive to seed and scene variation. Three-seed normal inference and SolarWM-FT references give FD 6.3/3.4 and key accuracy .801/.912. At 80 aligned autoregressive steps, their FD is 4.0/4.1 and deployed B1 is 9.8. These results show that both deployment execution and longer autoregressive histories affect rollout quality.
blocks.zh: 在20场停播一分钟的场景上,9对噪声种子的部署路径意味着FD 11.4和关键精度为772;故障部署聚变为8.3和785。 FD差异对种子和场景变化很敏感. 三种子正常推论和SolarWM-FT参考给出FD 6.3/3.4和密钥精度为.801/9.12. 在80个对齐的自动递减步骤中,它们的FD为4.0/4.1,部署的B1为9.8. 这些结果表明,部署执行和较长的自动递减历史都影响到推出质量。

blocks.en: In the native 16 fps four-action sweep, six-step sampling costs 89 ms per candidate. Preparation reduces Reactive’s presentation P99 from 498 to 373–374 ms: One Future gives a paired difference of − 124 -124 ms (95% CI [ − 188 , − 100 ] [-188,-100] ), and Four Futures gives − 125 -125 ms ( [ − 189 , − 103 ] [-189,-103] ). Four Futures also reduces restart empty ticks from Reactive’s 2.77% to 0.03%.

blocks.en: We extend ShowNow to a 33B camera-conditioned backbone by fine-tuning SolarWM-H3-33B for single-latent generation with One Future scheduling. At 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 resolution, generation and history commitment use eight-way sequence parallelism on B300 GPUs. With measured GPU generation and 47 ms per-latent decoding modeled on a dedicated ninth GPU, ShowNow-33B reduces median input-to-display latency from 862 to 232 ms (73%) and P99 from 1202 to 330 ms (73%) relative to the native deployment, while achieving 23.94 fps against a 24 fps target. These results demonstrate the framework’s applicability to larger models and high-resolution streaming. Figure 5 (b) shows nine generated sequences spanning indoor, outdoor and game scenes under recorded camera trajectories. Appendices H and J contain the full 33B timing setup and expanded visual sequences.

ShowNow-33B在专用的第九GPU上测得GPU生成量和47ms每纬度解码模型后,相对于本地部署,将中位输入对显示延迟度从862ms(73%)降低到232ms(73%),P99则从1202ms(33%)降低到330ms(73%),同时相对于24fps目标,实现了23.94英尺(23.94英尺). 这些结果表明,该框架适用于更大的模型和高分辨率流。 图5(b)显示在录制的相机轨迹下,在室内、室外和游戏场景中共有9个生成的序列。 附录H和J包含完整的33B定时设置和扩大的视觉序列.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented ShowNow, a streaming framework combining single-latent commitment, shared-history execution and advance preparation of action-conditioned futures. The system supports eight prepared futures at 16 fps on one H100. Matched-runtime comparisons link finer commitment to lower presentation latency. Execution optimizations reduce candidate cost and expand preparation capacity. Within the same student, preparation improves restart continuity and scheduled-target attainment while maintaining comparable presentation quantiles at the default operating point. At higher sampling cost, both single- and multi-future preparation improve presentation P99. Controlled switches and queue sweeps relate these benefits to candidate readiness, input timing and playback budgets, including shallow-buffer accelerated playback. Fine-grained autoregression also brings fidelity and long-horizon consistency trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了ShowNow(ShowNow)这个流派框架,结合了单向承诺,共享历史执行和预先准备有条件行动的未来. 该系统支持8个在1架H100上16英尺处准备的期货. 匹配的运行时间比较将更精细的承诺与更低的列报延迟联系起来. 执行优化可减少候选人费用,扩大准备能力。 在同一名学生中,准备可提高重新启动的连续性和预定目标实现率,同时在默认操作点保持可比的演示文稿量。 单一和多未来的准备工作以较高的取样成本改进了列报方式P99。 控制下的开关和排队检查将这些好处与候选人准备、投入时间和回放预算,包括缓冲加速回放有关。 精细的自旋也带来了忠贞和长距离一致性的权衡.

A shared engine-state mask confirms motion along the requested translation axis, yaw changes above 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} , visible attack state, or jump take-off. The same real-branch mask applies to every model, covering 76.8%/77.8% of validation/test latents. Transition uses latent ages 0 and 1 within each action segment (0.5 s at 16 fps); settled accuracy uses ages ≥ 2 \geq 2 . The same latent-index rule and real-branch mask apply to B1 and B3. Response delay compares the first generated and real recognition of the same switch, conditional on detection in both. LPIPS, PSNR and SSIM use matched real futures and Wan-VAE decoding. On 1808 real switches from 80 held-out-map forks, it detects 1740 (96.2%) within the new segment, including 1649 (91.2%) at the switch latent. These calibration clips are separate from the generated-video test states.

blocks.en: After 15 real introductory latents, each scene generates 60 s with a new key every 2 s; forward motion is twice as likely. Normal inference replays ShowNow’s recorded keys and nominal cameras. Key accuracy scores settled latents, at least two latent time steps (0.5 s) after switching. Feature distance (FD) compares 96-dimensional latent channel mean/std features against real video from the same scenes. Features are pooled across scenes within each five-second window; minute-average FD averages twelve windows. E3 uses TAEHV for display, while latent metrics are decoder-independent. Multi-seed results and their uncertainty appear in Sec. G .

blocks.zh: 如下文条件调整所述,培训混合了真实、名义和静态相机条件。

blocks.en: AnyFlow flow-map distillation transfers the teacher to a few-step student using tree teacher forcing [ 7 , 13 ] . The ShowNow student uses one-latent causal chunks with up to fifteen history latents; the SolarWM-FT student uses three-latent chunks. Initial student training also applies 0.25 ​ ℒ diff 0.25\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{diff}} on auxiliary updates, evaluating the instantaneous velocity at equal start and end times in the AnyFlow parameterization.
blocks.zh: 任何花流图蒸馏,将老师转移给几个步骤的学生,使用树教师强迫[7,13]. ShowNow学生使用最多15个历史潜伏的单倍因子块;SolarWM-FT学生使用三倍因子块. 初级学生培训也适用 0.25 Liff 0.25\ mathcal{L}_{\Q}_{\mathrm{diff}在辅助更新上,在 AnyFlow 参数化中,在相等的起始和结尾时间评价瞬时速度.

blocks.en: We refine the student on its own autoregressive histories through Self-Forcing [ 12 ] , using self-gradient forcing and distribution matching [ 35 , 30 ] . Cache-free tree rollouts are replayed with teacher forcing to supply gradients; the adapted teacher and learned critic score samples using bidirectional tree attention. The critic updates each iteration and the student every fifth iteration. Unconditional teacher guidance removes both action and future camera motion. The final eight-action student uses three denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 我们通过自我强迫[12],利用自我升级的强制力和配给[35,30]来完善学生自己的自递历史. 无缓存树的推出被重新播放,老师强迫提供梯度;经过改造的老师和学习的批评家使用双向树的注意力来评分样本. 评论家每一次重复更新一次,学生每第五次重复更新一次. 无条件的老师指导可以消除动作和未来相机运动. 最终的八项行动学生采用三个去名步骤.

blocks.en: SolarWM-FT and ShowNow use the same adapted teacher, training data and AnyFlow/distillation stages, with three- and single-latent blocks, respectively. Their student action learning rates are 10 − 4 10^{-4} and 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , respectively; the initial student branch-difference loss weights are 0 and 0.25. Timing and quality use the same trained model within each deployment; the B1 student is fixed across scheduling policies.
blocks.zh: SolarWM-FT和ShowNow使用相同的调整后的教师,培训数据和AnyFlow/distaination阶段,分别有三层和单层的块. 他们的学生动作学习率分别为10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4 10 - 4 3 - 4 3 - 10 - 4 3 - 4 ;最初的学生分支偏差减重为0和0.25。 时间安排和质量在每次部署中都采用同样的训练有素的模式;B1学生在时间安排政策中固定不变。

blocks.en: Our generator uses the SolarWM/Wan2.2 5B latent video transformer backbone [ 13 ] . Action embeddings modulate transformer blocks and the output head through timestep conditioning. We also add a zero-initialized action projection to patch-embedded tokens, providing a direct residual signal.
blocks.zh: 我们的发电机使用SolarWM/Wan2.2 5B型潜在视频变压器主干线[13]. 动作嵌入调制变压器块和输出头通过时序调节. 我们还增加了零初始动作投影到补丁嵌入的信号,提供直接的剩余信号.

blocks.en: Camera control uses the base model’s projective positional encoding. History uses recorded poses. At deployment, action-specific nominal curves specify translation and yaw, including view rotation for turning and vertical motion for jumping. At a key change, the next curve starts from the reached pose, so translation follows the updated view. Firing is represented through the action condition. Camera coordinates are rebased to the first latent and follow the base model’s frame-alignment convention. Simulator translation is scaled by 0.5; intrinsics use the base convention.
blocks.zh: 相机控制使用基型的投影定位编码. 历史使用记录的姿势. 在部署时,特定动作标称曲线指定了翻译和yaw,包括用于转动的视图旋转和用于跳跃的垂直运动. 在密钥变化时,下一个曲线从到达的姿势开始,所以翻译遵循更新的视图. 射击通过行动条件来表示。 相机坐标被重置到第一个潜伏点,并遵循基底模型的帧对齐协议. 模拟翻译量缩放0.5;内在使用基础常规.

blocks.en: To accommodate collisions and deployment conditions, training mixes real, nominal, and static future cameras. The final eight-action Stage 3 configuration uses real-camera probability 0.3 and static-camera probability 0.1. Nominal paths revert to real cameras when actual travel is below half the nominal distance. An unconditional mode removes future action and freezes the camera; single-trajectory examples use real or static/unconditional conditions. Evaluation uses nominal cameras.
blocks.zh: 为了适应碰撞和部署条件,培训混合了真实、名义和静止的未来摄像机。 最终的八动阶段3配置采用了真相机概率0.3和静相机概率0.1. 当实际旅行低于名义距离的一半时,名义路径恢复为真实摄像头. 无条件模式可以移除未来的动作并冻结相机;单导例使用真实或静态/无条件的条件. 评估使用名义摄像头。

blocks.en: For causal teacher forcing, clean queries see clean tokens from their lineage up to their own chunk. Noisy queries see prior clean chunks within a bounded window and noisy tokens in their own chunk. A cache-free autoregressive window uses the corresponding chunk-causal mask for a clean prefix and candidate noisy blocks. Training uses compiled block masks.
blocks.zh: 对于因果的老师强迫,干净的询问从他们的血统到自己的块都可以看到干净的符号. 声音模糊的查询在限定的窗口内看到先前的干净块, 在它们自己的块内看到噪音符号 。 一个缓存无自动递归的窗口使用相应的块-causal掩码,用于一个干净的前缀和候选的噪音块. 培训用途汇编成块口罩。

blocks.en: Appendix E Controlled Action Changes
blocks.zh: 附录E 控制下的行动变化

blocks.en: The controlled study comprises 2650 matched pairs (5300 four-second model traces) on six H100s on a shared node: 600 eight-action lead-sweep pairs, 450 four-action lead-sweep pairs, 1000 uniform-phase pairs and 600 brief-input burst pairs. The evaluation uses the eight-action, three-step student, 15 real history latents, optimized BF16/FA3 CUDA graphs and TAEHV. Four-action runs restrict the same model to WASD. Method order is counterbalanced and configuration order reversed on alternate GPUs; each pair shares a scene, input and device. Ten scenes, all trial counts and input seeds are fixed before measurement. Both policies share a 6 ms selection guard and four-frame FIFO. The final changed command arrives L L before a 2 s target and remains held through the end of the trace. We count a target hit when its first selected frame is scheduled no later than target + 2 +2 ms. Software presentation includes generation, commitment, decoding and queues. Both policies use the same input availability and commit rules. Every final command is served; unserved commands are assigned infinite latency.
blocks.zh: 控制研究由一个共享节点上的6个H100s上的2650对配对(5300四秒型号痕迹)组成:600对8动作铅洗,450对4动作铅洗,1000对统一相对和600对短输入爆破对. 评价采用八动作三步学生,15个真实历史潜伏,优化了BF16/FA3 CUDA图表和TAEHV. 四动作运行将同一型号限制在WASD. 方法顺序在备用的GPU上是反平衡的,配置顺序倒转;每对共享一个场景,输入和设备. 十幕,所有试算和输入种子在测量前都固定. 这两项政策都有一个6毫秒的甄选警卫和四个框架的FIFO。 最终变更的命令在2秒目标前到达LL,并保持通过跟踪的尽头. 我们计算一个目标被击中时,它的第一个选定框架的预定时间不晚于目标+2+2 ms. 软件演示包括生成,承诺,解码和排队. 这两项政策都使用同样的投入,并规定了规则。 每一个最终命令都得到执行;没有服务的命令被分配到无限的空位.

blocks.en: The eight-action sweep tests leads of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80, 100, 125, 150, 175, 200, 225 and 250 ms, with 30 pairs per point. The four-action sweep uses the same grid through 125 ms. Separate controls sample L L uniformly over the complete period, with 500 pairs per interface. Paired bootstrap intervals use 5000 resamples stratified by GPU; scene-cluster intervals provide a sensitivity check. Pointwise target-hit intervals are Wilson intervals.
blocks.zh: 八行动扫射试验领先0,2,4,6,8,10,15,20,30,40,50,60,80,100,125,150,175,200,225和250米,每点30对. 四动作扫码通过125ms使用相同的网格. 独立的控制样本LL在整个期间统一,每个接口有500对. Paired靴子间隔使用5000个重印由GPU分层;场景-集群间隔提供灵敏度检查. 指针打击的间隔是威尔逊的间隔.

blocks.en: Table S7 : Uniform-phase response controls. Each interface uses 500 paired GPU switches. Input lead is uniform over the full four-frame period: 250 ms at 16 fps and 125 ms at 32 fps. The latter plays 16 fps-trained content at 2 × 2\times speed.
blocks.zh: 表S7:统一相响应控制。 每个接口使用500对GPU开关. 输入铅在完整的四帧周期内是统一的:16英尺时250ms,32英尺时125ms. 后者以2×2\时速播放16个fps训练内容.

blocks.en: For eight actions, the paired mean latency reduction is 9.25 ms (95% CI [7.00,12.00]; scene-cluster CI [6.75,11.75]), and target attainment increases by 13.0 percentage points [10.2,16.0]. Four actions give 9.19 ms [7.44,10.94] and 25.0 points [20.6,29.6]. The full-distribution percentiles in Table S7 remain close; the improvement is concentrated in meeting the display deadline.
blocks.zh: 对于8项行动,配对的平均耐用性减少为9.25毫秒(95%CI [7.00,12.00];场景集群CI [6.75,11.75]),目标实现率增加13.0%[10.2,16.0]。 4个动作给出9.19毫秒[7.44,10.94]和25.0分[20.6,29.6]. 表S7中的全额分配百分位数仍然接近;改进集中在遵守显示期限。

blocks.en: Figure S1 extends the eight-action lead sweep in the main text to the four-action, 32 fps interface. With stationary arrivals and independent display phase, lead to a periodic target is uniform over the period. The 6–40 ms window therefore occupies 13.6% of a 250 ms period and 27.2% of a 125 ms period. The uniform-phase control measures the average over the complete period. At leads of 50–125 ms, Four Futures has some lower target-hit estimates than One Future. Its 119.5 ms fused update plus 3.45 ms decode leaves approximately 2 ms within the 125 ms period; the sweep retains candidate-readiness and scheduling misses.
blocks.zh: 图S1将正文中的八动铅扫描扩展至四动,32 fps接口. 随着固定抵达和独立展示阶段,实现定期目标在这一期间是统一的。 因此,6至40 ms的窗口占250 ms的13.6%,占125 ms的27.2%。 统一阶段控制衡量整个期间的平均数。 在50–125 ms的领先,"四个未来"(Four Futures)拥有一些低于"一个未来"的目标打击估计. 它的119.5毫秒的更新加上3.45毫秒的解码在125毫秒的时间内留下大约2毫秒;扫描保留了候选状态和排程误差。

blocks.en: The 600 burst pairs cover both interfaces at mean inter-command gaps of 30, 50 and 80 ms, with 100 pairs per setting. Each burst has five commands; the final command arrives 10–40 ms before the target and remains held. Eight Futures meets that target in all trials, versus 0–8% for One Future; the four-action rates are 92–99% versus 0–2%. At 16 fps and 30/50 ms gaps, neither policy displays any of the 400 intermediate commands before their successors. These trials measure final-command settling; the uniform-phase controls in Table S7 cover the complete arrival period.
blocks.zh: 600爆裂的对子在平均指令间间间隙30,50和80ms时覆盖两个接口,每设定100对. 每一次爆破有5个指令;最终指令到达目标前10–40 ms,并保留至今. 在所有试验中,8个未来都达到了这一目标,而 " 一个未来 " 是0-8 % ; 四行动率是92-99 % , 而0-2%。 在16英尺/秒和30/50米/秒的空隙中,政策都没有在继任者之前显示任何400个中间命令. 这些试验衡量最终命令的结算;表S7中的统一阶段控制涵盖完整的抵达期。

blocks.en: Figure S1 : Measured four-action response window at a 32 fps playback target. Thirty paired trials per lead, with the same checkpoint and scheduling rules as Figure 3 . Error bars show median-bootstrap or Wilson 95% intervals. The lead sweep measures target attainment across input phases; beyond 50 ms lead, single-future preparation often meets the target too. Playback is 2 × 2\times the 16 fps training rate.
blocks.zh: 图S1:测量在32 fps回放目标上的四动响应窗口. 每条线索进行30对审判,检查站和时间安排规则与图3相同。 错误栏显示中位值- bootstrap 或 Wilson 95% 间隔 。 铅扫荡措施的目标是实现各个投入阶段的目标;超过50毫秒的铅,单一未来的准备也往往达到目标。 回放为2×2\times 16 fps训练率.

blocks.en: Appendix F Generation Cost at Native Playback

blocks.en: We run the student on an exclusive H100 with optimized execution, four actions (W/S/A/D), one-frame queue threshold and native 16 fps playback. Each policy receives identical traces at the four input rates in Sec. A , 60 s per trace and three seeds (921 scored inputs per policy per sampling-step setting). Increasing sampling steps from three to four to six raises single-candidate generation plus fused commitment from 50 to 63 to 89 ms; four-candidate updates cost 121/156/226 ms. Those update costs include generation and fused commitment. The presentation measurements below additionally include TAEHV decoding and queueing.

Bootstrap估计使用2000对复标的3个种子集群. 差异在显示的四舍五入前计算。

blocks.en: Table S9 reports the fixed eight-action student on validation and independent test states. Normal inference recomputes history with a cache-free tree sampler; real-time inference caches history and prepares eight candidates. Conditioning controls remove actions and/or camera motion at inference without retraining. Removing the action input at inference reduces validation accuracy from .874 to .200; additionally freezing the future camera gives .139. The independent test uses 96 states disjoint from the validation states used for model selection.
blocks.zh: 表S9报告固定的八项行动学生的验证和独立测试状态。 正常推论用一个缓存无树采样器来重新计算历史;实时推论缓存历史,并准备8名候选人. 附加条件控制在不进行再培训的情况下删除推断的动作和/或相机运动. 推论中移除动作输入会降低验证精度,从874降至.200;此外,未来相机会冻结.139。 独立测试使用96个状态与用于模型选择的验证状态脱节.

blocks.en: Using TAEHV on the same saved E2 validation rollouts, while keeping the Wan-decoded real reference, gives one-second LPIPS/PSNR/SSIM of .407/19.63/.572 for the teacher, .422/18.89/.559 for SolarWM-FT and .456/17.76/.530 for ShowNow. TAEHV increases LPIPS by .019–.034 across models and horizons; PSNR changes by at most .13 dB and SSIM by at most .002. Model ordering is preserved. Real latents decoded by TAEHV versus Wan VAE give LPIPS .141, PSNR 30.39 dB and SSIM .834. Latent IDM scores are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 在同一保存的E2验证推出上使用TAEHV,同时保留了Wan-decode的真实参考,给出了1秒钟的LPIPS/PSNR/SSIM,教师为407/19.63/572,SolarWM-FT为422/18.89/559,ShowNow为456/17.76/530. TAEHV在模型和地平线上增加了LPIPS的0.019–.034;PSNR的改变最多为13 dB,SSIM的改变最多为.002. 模型订购被保存. 由TAEHV对Wan VAE进行解码的真正潜伏给LPIPS 141,PSNR 30.39 dB和SSIM 834. 后期IDM分数不变.

Generation and commitment are timed with eight-way B300 sequence parallelism at 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 . The evaluation models an additional, independent decoder GPU: decoding is represented by a fixed 47 ms per latent, calibrated from a separate B300 SolarRenderer demo using the same H3 VAE and resolution. A playback thread consumes available frames in order at 24 fps and records empty ticks when the next frame is unavailable. blocks.en: Appendix I Scope and Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 附录一 范围和失败模式

blocks.en: Response can exceed one 250 ms update when a command is superseded before commitment: successor waiting can span later inputs or released-key intervals. Decoding and queueing add to presentation latency. All such events remain in the continuous-stream estimator. At rapid input rates, multiple changes can occur within one latent, so the committed stream follows the selected command and may omit intermediate commands.
blocks.zh: 当一个命令在承诺之前被取代时,响应可以超过一个250毫秒的更新:继任者等待的时间可以跨过以后的输入或释放键间隔. 解码和排队增加了演示文稿的延迟性. 所有此类事件都处于连续流估计中。 在快速输入速率下,在一个潜伏内可以发生多个变化,因此承诺流遵循选定的指令,可能会省略中间指令.

blocks.en: The framework optimizes response scheduling and supports short-horizon action changes. It uses bounded visual history, with no explicit persistent scene memory or revisit-consistency objective. Long rollouts can drift in appearance or reconstruct revisited regions differently. The multi-seed results in Sec. G quantify the accompanying quality changes. Shared attention is algebraically equivalent over the allowed partitions; cached and cache-free autoregressive executions can still accumulate numerical and history differences.
blocks.zh: 该框架优化了响应调度,并支持短视动作变化. 它使用有界限的视觉历史,没有明显的持续场景记忆或重温一致性目标. 长期推出可能会在外表上漂移,或以不同方式重建重新审视的区域。 多种子结果 Sec. G 量化伴随的质量变化。 共同关注是相对于允许的分区的代数等同;缓存和缓存的自动递归处决仍然可以积累数字和历史差异.

blocks.en: Matched training futures require a simulator or game engine that can restore a common state and record alternative outcomes and camera poses. Multi-action evidence covers eight mutually exclusive ViZDoom controls and synthetic input traces; the 33B extension evaluates single-future camera-conditioned generation across broader scenes. Larger discrete or continuous control spaces call for limited candidate budgets guided by action predictions or sampled proposals. Real-player traces and perceptual evaluation would connect scheduled-frame gains to user experience.
blocks.zh: 匹配的训练期货需要一个模拟器或游戏引擎,可以恢复一个共同状态,并记录替代结果和相机的姿势. 多动作证据涵盖8个相互排斥的ViZDoom控制和合成输入痕迹;33B扩展评价跨大场景的单未来相机条件生成. 更大的离散或连续的控制空间需要以行动预测或抽样建议为指导的有限候选人预算。 真正的玩家追踪和知觉评价将把预定范围的收益与用户经验联系起来。
